faults.page says: The 6 March 2026 recruitment notice names 中国共产党历史展览馆 (Exhibition Hall of CPC History) among 17 units directly under the Central Publicity Department; it does not name the Museum of the Communist Party of China and states no legal form for it

The notice says units other than two named companies are public institutions on the state public-institution pay system, but the museum is not named, so the fact is inferred from a list the page does not give

faults.stored: Publicity Department of the CPC Central Committee
faults.page says: Only the unnamed '17 units' are said to be directly under the Department; the museum is not listed on the page
